companions.label: live rig state
companions._note: Generates the box's REAL observe-state from the running rig, replacing the SDK's shipped demo fixture. Declaring {{state}} is what points the runtime here. Without it a deployed studio renders an invented rig under a live dot.

_why_this_file_exists: THIS COMPANION USED TO LIVE ON AN APP, AND AN APP WAS DELETED. Retiring the AGENTS surface removed the only declaration of {{state}} anywhere, so nothing started the live-state generator and a deployed box's landing page served an invented rig with four invented seats under a green live signal — while eleven real ones were running on it. FILES and AGENTS had both declared this same provider with byte-identical run specs; only AGENTS' copy carried the companion. Repairing it by moving the companion to FILES pinned the bug rather than removing it: retire FILES the same way and rig state dies again. The capability belongs to the package that ships live-state.mjs, which is this one, so it can no longer depend on which app happens to be installed.
